_about: Public-domain Isaac Massey Haldeman (1845-1933), pastor of First Baptist Church, New York, and premillennial writer, for the Word Hoard: Friday Night Papers (1901), How to Study the Bible (1904), The Coming of Christ (1906), Christian Science in the Light of Holy Scripture (1909), The Signs of the Times (1910), Christ, Christianity and the Bible (1912), Ten Sermons on the Second Coming (1917), Why I Preach the Second Coming (1919) and Can the Dead Communicate with the Living? (1920). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 73 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
